tweet_pool.text: 5.6 livestream going now. in addition to the model, 3 major product things: 1. ChatGPT Work--really big deal! 2. new ChatGPT desktop app 3. hosted sites

tweet_pool.author: OpenAI
tweet_pool.text: Introducing ChatGPT Work, a new agent in ChatGPT powered by Codex and GPT-5.6. It can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Primary product announcement of ChatGPT Work agent; highest-reach official post.

tweet_pool.author: OpenAIDevs
tweet_pool.text: We're bringing Codex and ChatGPT together in one desktop app. New coding workflows, a new Chrome extension, revamped in-app browser, and faster Computer Use powered by GPT-5.6.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Distinct developer-facing detail: unified Codex/ChatGPT desktop app and Computer Use.

tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.text: we have heard enterprises on their concerns about AI costs, and 5.6 sol is a huge step forward for dollars-per-task, as are terra and luna.

tweet_pool.author: finkd
tweet_pool.text: Today we're releasing Muse Spark 1.1 -- a strong agentic and coding model at a very low price. It's available through our new Meta Model API and in Meta AI.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Zuckerberg releasing Muse Spark 1.1 and a new Meta Model API; major competing model launch.

tweet_pool.author: elonmusk
tweet_pool.text: I was clearly wrong about Anthropic. They are obviously currently the leader in AI. No company has released a model as good as Mythos/Fable. And I would never cut them off in a way that hurt them badly.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Musk publicly calls Anthropic the AI leader and disavows cutting off its compute; high-signal company/competitive move.

tweet_pool.author: yacineMTB
tweet_pool.text: SpaceXAI now has a legitimate frontier model that competes with opus 4.8. Also, Anthropic is completely reliant on the compute rented from SpaceXAI. If Elon wanted to kill anthropic, he could.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely-shared claim about Anthropic's compute dependence on SpaceXAI; context for the Musk post.

tweet_pool.author: claudeai

tweet_pool.selection_reason: Anthropic ships a usage-reflection/wellbeing feature (Reflect); concrete product news.
